
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/p/19689129" title="发布于 2026-03-09 12:37">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">what():  EGL error 0x300c at eglBindAPI  已放弃 (核心已转储)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>博客地址：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>把只适配老旧单显卡桌面系统的 C++ 模拟器（Matterport3DSimulator），修改为能兼容现代双显卡笔记本（Optimus 架构）的版本。</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>使用的是带 NVIDIA 和 Intel 双显卡的笔记本，而且连接了外接显示器。在这种环境下，系统的显示环境变量（$DISPLAY）处于一种非常复杂的混合状态。</p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="实现效果">实现效果</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260309113318921-707692546.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd /home/yehuo/VLN_learning/Matterport3DSimulator

./build/mattersim_main
</code></pre>
<h1 id="mattersimcpp">MatterSim.cpp</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>/home/yehuo/VLN_learning/Matterport3DSimulator/src/lib/MatterSim.cpp</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>主要的修改都在于从严格的“桌面级 OpenGL”兼容到“嵌入式 OpenGL ES”</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="api-降级绑定">API 降级绑定</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>在初始化时，如果桌面级 EGL_OPENGL_API 绑定失败，让它自动降级使用 EGL_OPENGL_ES_API。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260309123021325-1970051628.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">if (eglBindAPI(EGL_OPENGL_API) == EGL_FALSE) {
            std::cerr &lt;&lt; "Warning: EGL_OPENGL_API failed. Falling back to EGL_OPENGL_ES_API..." &lt;&lt; std::endl;
            eglBindAPI(EGL_OPENGL_ES_API);
        }
</code></pre>
<h2 id="配置属性匹配">配置属性匹配</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>将 EGL_RENDERABLE_TYPE 从 EGL_OPENGL_BIT 修改为了支持 ES 规范的 EGL_OPENGL_ES2_BIT | EGL_OPENGL_ES3_BIT。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260309122426212-346785540.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">EGL_RENDERABLE_TYPE, EGL_OPENGL_ES2_BIT | EGL_OPENGL_ES3_BIT,
</code></pre>
<h2 id="上下文版本升级">上下文版本升级</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>在 eglCreateContext 时，指定 EGL_CONTEXT_CLIENT_VERSION 为 3（即 OpenGL ES 3.0），以支持高级的图像内存对齐功能。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260309122517037-1356118372.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">EGL_CONTEXT_CLIENT_VERSION, 3,
</code></pre>
<h2 id="颜色通道修正">颜色通道修正</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>在 glReadPixels 从显卡读取渲染结果时，将非标准的 GL_BGR 改为标准的 GL_RGB，并在读取后手动调用 cv::cvtColor 将其转换回 OpenCV 需要的 BGR 格式。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260309122829126-727663800.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">glReadPixels(0, 0, img.cols, img.rows, GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, img.data);
</code></pre>
<h1 id="navgraphcpp">NavGraph.cpp</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>/home/yehuo/VLN_learning/Matterport3DSimulator/src/lib/NavGraph.cpp</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>图像纹理上传规范化</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="输入颜色修正">输入颜色修正</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>在读取 _skybox_small.jpg 后，立刻使用 cv::cvtColor 将 BGR 转为 RGB。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260309123548340-1208534585.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">cv::cvtColor(rgb, rgb, cv::COLOR_BGR2RGB);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="纹理通道修正">纹理通道修正</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>将所有 glTexImage2D 调用中的 GL_BGR 枚举全部替换为 GL_RGB。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260309123432007-546353050.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_X, 0, GL_RGB, xpos.rows, xpos.cols, 0, GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, xpos.ptr());
    glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_X, 0, GL_RGB, xneg.rows, xneg.cols, 0, GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, xneg.ptr());
    glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_Y, 0, GL_RGB, ypos.rows, ypos.cols, 0, GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, ypos.ptr());
    glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_Y, 0, GL_RGB, yneg.rows, yneg.cols, 0, GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, yneg.ptr());
    glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_Z, 0, GL_RGB, zpos.rows, zpos.cols, 0, GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, zpos.ptr());
    glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_Z, 0, GL_RGB, zneg.rows, zneg.cols, 0, GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, zneg.ptr());
</code></pre>
<h2 id="剔除废弃函数">剔除废弃函数</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>删除了在现代 OpenGL 中属于非法调用的 glEnable(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP)。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260309123359569-349290255.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>


</div>
